title: Hunts FH-016T: Visited-stops map, on-page scan entry and end-to-end player acceptance

source.ref: Split from FH-016S (2026-11-15): the claim action, visited list and hint safety shipped; the map, scan entry and live acceptance remain.

detail:
Add the map of visited stops from an authorized source of locations (visited stops only), the camera or scan entry on the player page, and run-version mission binding hardening. Done when: a player completes a Trail end to end from the page against a real database, a second device shows the same revision, and a hidden clue never reaches the page source. Requires: FH-016S, FH-049T. Owner role: Web.

Closed 2026-11-16 for what was built. Map: components/hunts/visited-stops-map.tsx draws the visited stops through the map seam, loaded on demand on the play page only. The location source is the venue Space bound to the stop on the run's version, at the precision that Space publishes (lib/hunts/run-store.ts loadVisitedStopPoints, filtered to credited stops in the query); lib/hunts/player.ts visitedPins is a second gate, and the page test feeds it a source that returns every stop and asserts the serialised map props and the page source carry no unvisited stop, place, point, clue or hint. A stop with no venue Space has no pin. Scan entry: the play page links to the existing scanner (/scan, hint trail), which navigates a Trail code to the existing confirm step. Binding: lib/hunts/claim-store.ts takes the version from the run row, resolves the mission on that version only after the run is known, and refuses a run pinned elsewhere (version_superseded) before a token or a mission lookup. Not done here: the live end-to-end run against a real database and the second-device same-revision check, split to FH-016V.
